standard.summary: 启用 micro-batch 拆分执行。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用 micro-batch 拆分执行。很强的保命项，但通常会明显降低速度；只有单步 batch 接近 OOM 时再开

advanced_en.principle: Enables micro-batch split execution. A very strong life-saver, but usually slows things down noticeably; only turn it on when a single-step batch is close to OOM.
